title: Endosymbiosis — rich
forward_vector: I am the manifest of Endosymbiosis's rich face: what was made for each section, and the fingerprint of the words each piece was made against, so the page can say when a piece may lag the text. I grow when the entry is enriched again; I never hold the entry's words.
note: A light face, from the light round of 2026-11: one small thing beside one sentence, not a walk up to a test. pieces.file: Endosymbiosis — rich — two rhythms become one.m4a
pieces.title: Two rhythms become one
pieces.caption: Press play; the picture beneath says what you are hearing. *What is real and what is a choice:* A two-oscillator Kuramoto model, the page's own image. It is not a model of a cell.

pieces.file: Endosymbiosis — rich — two rhythms become one — picture.svg
pieces.title: Two rhythms become one · drawn
pieces.caption: Two tones seven hertz apart, beating against each other. From four seconds the coupling between them rises: the beat slows, lurches, and near nine seconds they lock onto one pitch that neither started on. Each keeps its own timbre to the end, hollow in the left ear and round in the right.

verdicts.file: Endosymbiosis — rich — two rhythms become one.m4a
verdicts.why: It is the page's sentence made audible: two oscillators coupled until they are one system at a new frequency. The honest line is true. Two small fixes: the picture's two top labels run together into one line, and "hollow in the left ear, round in the right" is a lean, not a separation.
